title: ken-3: USB flash backend ops + C_Login/C_Logout keystore integration
description:
Wire the keystore module into PKCS#11 operations.

Changes:
- wolfp11/wp11_backend.h: add WP11_BACKEND_USB_FLASH = 3
- src/wp11_backend_usb_flash.c: sign (RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 + ECDSA P-256), verify, decrypt (RSA OAEP) — dispatching into decrypted wp11_key_entry_t from keystore
- src/wp11_pkcs11.c: flash slots store wp11_keystore_t* in slot priv pointer; C_Login calls wp11_keystore_load(path, pin); C_Logout/slot_remove_flash calls wp11_keystore_free (zeroizes)
